draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.39, the 27th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 4th of 36 at CB. He went 41st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: A.J. Terrell. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 7 passes defended in 2023, 11th of 34 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the New Orleans Saints. 32 career games and 26 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 7 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: season snap share 97.7% (98th percentile), passes defended 17 (97th percentile), approximate value 7 (93rd percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 cornerback who played: 97.7% season snap share against a median of 27.8%, above the norm.
